clues.it: Marta era nella stessa stanza di Paolo.
clues.en: Marta was in the same room as Paolo.

clues.it: Ugo era accanto a un abbeveratoio.
clues.en: Ugo was beside a water trough.

clues.it: Giada era da sola nel Saloon.
clues.en: Giada was alone in the Saloon.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un bancone.
clues.en: Elena was beside a bar counter.

clues.it: Nino era l'unico seduto su una sedia.
clues.en: Nino was the only one sitting on a chair.

steps.it: L'indizio di Elena lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Elena's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 1st.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 8ª colonna: escludendola, a Ugo resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 8th column: ruling it out leaves Ugo a single square: row 3rd, column 7th.

steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 1st row.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Paolo con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Paolo's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 1st, column 8th.
